publications.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
publications.description: A unified world action model for 3D perception, video prediction, and goal-directed dexterous planning.
publications.summary: P³-WAM jointly models visual observations and structured 3D hand and camera actions in a video diffusion transformer. Shared training supports video-to-motion reconstruction, action-conditioned video prediction, and goal-conditioned planning, including optional visual goals.
publications.image_alt: P³-WAM examples of 3D hand reconstruction from egocentric video

publications.title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
publications.description: Persistent visual memory through test-time training for consistent, real-time video world generation.
publications.summary: World-T3 uses camera-pose-keyed test-time training to store scene information in fast weights. A recursive least-squares update maintains visual memory beyond the active context, and few-step distillation supports real-time camera-controlled generation and scene revisits.
publications.image_alt: A generated dining room from the World-T3 scene revisit example

publications.title: Latent Dynamics for Full Body Avatar Animation
publications.description: History-dependent clothing motion through controllable latent dynamics in full-body Gaussian avatars.
publications.summary: The method augments a pose-conditioned Gaussian avatar with a transformer decoder and an evolving residual latent. Learned driving, restoring, and dissipative forces model history-dependent garment motion and expose controls such as stiffness.
publications.image_alt: Full-body avatars reconstruct and animate loose dresses with controllable garment dynamics

publications.title: HyperBones: Realtime Bone-driven Neural Garment Simulation with Hypernetwork Conditioning
publications.description: Real-time neural garment simulation with virtual bones, fine wrinkle detail, and hypernetwork conditioning.
publications.summary: HyperBones predicts virtual-bone garment deformations and recovers fine detail with a UV-space neural model. Hypernetwork conditioning separates identity-dependent features from per-frame updates, while physics-based self-supervision teaches dynamic behavior without precomputed simulation data.
publications.image_alt: Virtual-bone driven garment simulation with fine-scale cloth wrinkles

publications.title: Joint Learning of Depth and Appearance for Portrait Images
publications.preprint_title: Joint Learning of Depth and Appearance for Portrait Image Animation
publications.venue: Workshop on Human-Interactive Generation and Editing
publications.booktitle: Workshop on Human-Interactive Generation and Editing
publications.description: Joint diffusion modeling of portrait appearance and depth for consistent image manipulation and animation.
publications.summary: A diffusion generator jointly learns portrait appearance and depth using a reference network and an expanded diffusion backbone. The resulting shared representation supports consistent RGB/depth generation, facial depth estimation, and depth-driven portrait editing and animation.
publications.image_alt: A reference-guided diffusion model jointly generates a portrait RGB image and its depth map
